articles.summary: Highlights: Net income of $22.8 million, or $0.88 per diluted share Net interest margin increased by 5 bps to 3.62% from the prior quarter Return on average assets of 1.22% and return on average equity of 15.28% Efficiency ratio improved to 58.27%, compared to 59.62% in the prior quarter Repurchased 294,110 shares of common stock at a total cost of $11.2 million during the quarter Board of Directors declared a fourth quarter cash dividend of $0.31 per share, an increase of 3.3% from prior quarter Central Pacific Financial Corp. (NYSE: CPF) (the "Company"), parent company of Central Pacific Bank (the "Bank" or "CPB"), reported net income of $22.8 million, or $0.88 diluted earnings per share ("EPS"), for the third quarter of 2026. This compares to net income of $20.8 million, or diluted EPS of $0.80, in the prior quarter and $18.6 million, or diluted EPS of $0.69, in the same period last year. articles.summary: Central Pacific Bank (CPB) is pleased to announce that its Kapiolani Branch has temporarily relocated from 1538 Kapiolani Blvd., Suite 103, to the Pan Am Building, located just one block away at 1600 Kapiolani Blvd., Suite 110. The new branch celebrated its soft opening with a traditional blessing ceremony on Tuesday, Oct. 13, 2026.
articles.title: Central Pacific Bank's Kapiolani Branch Temporarily Relocates to the Pan Am Building

articles.summary: Central Pacific Financial Corp. (NYSE: CPF), parent company of Central Pacific Bank, will release its third quarter 2026 financial results on October 28, 2026, before the market opens. Management will review the results by conference call and live audio webcast beginning at 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time (8:00 a.m. Hawaii Time) on October 28, 2026. Interested parties may listen to the conference by calling 1-833-461-5787 (Meeting ID: 104 617 134), or by registering for the webcast at the following link: https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/104617134 . The Company’s investor relations website, https://ir.cpb.bank , will also include a link to the webcast and a slide presentation. A replay of the call will be available through October 28, 2027, on the Company’s investor relations website. About Central Pacific Financial Corp.
